colors.rule: Never use pure #000000 or full transparent headers. Use glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 or bg-slate-900/90.

automated_gates.description: Architectural and technical drawing / schematic illustrations of driveway gates and entrance automation

electrical_wiring.description: Technical schematic, wiring blueprint, and electrical panel cutaway illustrations

layout_and_spacing.grid: Base grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 with gap-8 or gap-12
layout_and_spacing.card_aspect_ratio: roughly 600x460px (aspect ratio 4:3 / 16:10) for service card grid
layout_and_spacing.hero_aspect_ratio: 1200x460px landscape orientation for detailed service view
layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous internal padding p-6 or p-8 inside bordered cards

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid slate-200 with subtle hover shadow transition
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border border-slate-200/60 for navigation & floating bars
visual_enhancers.textures: Technical grid lines or light architectural noise overlays

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: Mandatory data-testid on all interactive buttons, card containers, and image elements (e.g. data-testid="automated-gates-service-card", data-testid="electrical-wiring-service-image")
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio (> 4.5:1 for body text, > 3:1 for headers and buttons)
testing_and_accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: Honor prefers-reduced-motion in Framer Motion / CSS transitions

instructions_to_main_agent:
1. Replace AI-generated service card and hero images for Automated Gates and Electrical Wiring with the curated technical drawing / illustration style URLs provided in `image_urls`.
2. Ensure image wrappers preserve landscape aspect ratio (600x460px for card view, 1200x460px for detail/hero view) with proper rounded borders (`rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl`) and shadow transitions.
3. Verify all interactive components have appropriate `data-testid` attributes in JS format.
4. Avoid complete transparent headers or generic stock photos; retain technical precision branding for Cleverhouse Philippines.
